name: C. S. Peirce
biography: Credited by James as the original source of the pragmatist principle: that to attain clarity about an object we need only consider its conceivable practical effects. Quoted for his definition of truth, which Dewey approvingly cites: 'the opinion which is fated to be ultimately agreed to by all who investigate.'
